title: Connected globe illustration
slide_intent: Give an abstract idea a visible relationship. Portraits and connecting paths can suggest people working across distances without a written explanation.
strategic_value: Slack can make global collaboration feel personal by giving the people on the map faces and distinct colors.
demonstration: Seven portraits occupy positions on a pale globe with green land masses. Fine dotted paths cross the sphere, and a long black shadow extends to the right.
practical_value: Use this as a reference for combining a global view with human-scale details. Keep the portrait shapes legible against the land and path network.

content_islands.name: Globe and contacts
content_islands.spec: Center the tilted globe on a white page. Position small colorful portraits at points across its surface and run dotted loops between them.

content_islands.name: Cast shadow
content_islands.spec: Project a flat dark shadow from the globe’s base to the right. Leave open space above and around the illustration.
